phase_contract: open_ns=Editor::open; stage_ns=put_streams_shared replace_and_validate; finish_ns=Editor::finish; whole_ns spans the same editor lifecycle
policy_contract: Reuse preserves the normalized raw directory image outside planner-owned allocation fields; Rewrite may normalize physical directory layout and timestamps. Both policies must preserve logical streams, semantic directory metadata, root/storage CLSIDs, and public edit meaning; raw differences are reported in raw_directory and directory_metadata_differences
allocation_ownership_contract: Each allocation region reports boundary-relative allocations. The opened Editor is retained from open through replace_and_validate; the staged Editor is retained until finish; the returned Vec is retained across finish. Format output is also retained outside its region for validation. retained_bytes is live ownership at the region boundary, not RSS.
